aboutTitle: What does the Slug Generator do?
about: Turn a title or phrase into a URL slug. Choose the available separator and word-removal options, then review and copy the result.
example: Enter "Garden Planning Guide" and use a hyphen separator to produce "garden-planning-guide". Review the result before using it in your page URL.

faqs.question: Does generating a slug change my website URL?
faqs.answer: No. Copy the result into your website's URL or permalink field to use it.

faqs.question: Can I change the slug of an existing page?
faqs.answer: Yes, but changing a published URL can affect existing links. Set up a redirect from the previous URL when making that change.
